connections.title: Connections and services
connections.description: Check the services used by the application from the Laravel server.
connections.databaseDescription: Runs a read query on the primary connection without changing any data.
connections.storageDescription: Creates, reads and deletes a temporary file on the selected storage: local, S3/R2 or another configured service.
connections.notaryDisabled: Automatic notarization is disabled. The connection can still be checked.
connections.requestFailed: Unable to run the diagnostic. Check your session, permissions and application availability, then try again.

codes.database_ok: The database responded to the read query.
codes.database_unavailable: The database did not respond. Check the service, connection settings and permissions.
codes.storage_ok: The temporary file was written, read and deleted successfully.
codes.storage_configuration_missing: Complete the storage configuration. S3/R2 requires a bucket and region.
codes.storage_driver_missing: The S3/R2 driver is missing on the server. Install league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3 before checking this connection.
codes.storage_unavailable: Storage is unavailable or access was denied. Check the configuration and permissions.
codes.storage_write_failed: Unable to write the temporary file. Check write permissions.
codes.storage_read_failed: The temporary file could not be read back correctly.
codes.storage_cleanup_failed: Deletion of the temporary file could not be confirmed. Check delete permissions in the .starter-diagnostics folder.
codes.mail_ok: The SMTP server accepts the connection and the check command. Email delivery has not been verified.
codes.mail_local_only: The log or array driver keeps messages locally. Configure an SMTP service to check an external mail connection.
codes.mail_unsupported: Connection diagnostics support SMTP. The configured mail service uses a different transport and has not been checked.
codes.mail_configuration_missing: Complete the mail service configuration, including the SMTP server and port.
codes.mail_unavailable: The SMTP connection failed. Check the server, port, credentials and TLS settings.
codes.push_ok: The broadcasting API accepts authentication and channel listing. Notification delivery has not been verified.
codes.push_configuration_missing: No usable external push service is configured. Configure broadcasting and the provider credentials.
codes.push_driver_missing: The Pusher/Reverb driver is missing on the server. Install the provider driver before checking this connection.
codes.push_unsupported: Connection diagnostics support Pusher and Reverb. The configured provider has not been checked.
codes.push_unavailable: The push service is unavailable or rejected the request. Check its credentials, address and permissions.
codes.horizon_ok: Redis responds and Horizon reports active workers for the main queue. Actual job execution has not been tested.
codes.horizon_queue_not_redis: The main queue does not use Redis. Horizon only supports Redis queues.
codes.horizon_inactive: No recent Horizon supervisor is detected for this environment. Check that the worker service is running.
codes.horizon_paused: A Horizon supervisor is paused or is not running.
codes.horizon_no_workers: Horizon is present but no active worker is reported for the main queue. Check the configured queues and processes.
codes.horizon_unavailable: Redis or Horizon metadata is inaccessible. Check the Redis connection and Horizon configuration.
codes.scheduler_inactive: No recent heartbeat. Check the scheduler container and shared cache.
codes.scheduler_shared_cache_required: Configure shared cache between web and scheduler (Redis recommended).

connections.mailDescription: Opens an SMTP session using the application configuration. No email is sent.
connections.pushDescription: Checks access to the Pusher/Reverb broadcasting API and the realtime client status in this browser. No notification is sent.
connections.horizonDescription: Checks Redis and recent Horizon supervisor and worker heartbeats for the main queue. No job is executed.

pushClient.connected: The browser realtime client is connected. Notification reception has not been tested.
pushClient.disconnected: The browser realtime client is present but its connection has not been confirmed.
pushClient.missing: The realtime client is not initialized in this browser. It cannot receive push notifications.

connections.schedulerDescription: Checks a heartbeat written every minute to shared cache. Does not guarantee that every task succeeds.
